name: s_waystone
prompt: A sprite sheet of 3 different designs of a magical teleport waystone for a cozy island farming game, all drawn in straight-on FRONT VIEW like Stardew Valley objects (not isometric, not angled), at the SAME pixel scale as the reference decorations, arranged in ONE row with generous empty white space between them. Each one is a single tall weathered grey standing stone (an obelisk about twice as tall as it is wide) carved with glowing cyan-teal spiral runes, standing on a small round flat stone platform. Design 1: plain mossy obelisk with a glowing rune circle in the middle. Design 2: obelisk with a small brass bell and a rope tied around it and a glowing rune. Design 3: obelisk with a floating glowing teal crystal on top. Warm friendly look, not scary. No text, no letters
